import markdown

print("Test 1 - Basic header:")

# Test 2: Unicode header

text = '# Ünïcödé Héader'

text = '''# Header[^1]

Some text.

[^1]: Footnote text
'''
html = md.convert(text)
print("Test 3 - With footnotes:")
print(html)
print("toc_tokens:", md.toc_tokens)
print()

### H3
'''
